text: A tank you can carry. The flask holds one fluid, **4,000 mB** (4 buckets) — the **Greater Spirit Flask** holds **16,000 mB**, as much as a [Spirit Cistern](spirit_cistern).
It never splits into a stack of buckets, and the amount it holds shows as a bar under the icon in the fluid's own colour.

pages.title: Filling and pouring
text: - **Use it on a tank or machine** (a cistern, a Wave Drum, a fluid relay, another mod's tank) and it draws from it; if it cannot draw, it pours in what it carries instead.
- **Use it on a fluid source in the world** and it drinks a bucket of it.
- **Sneak-use** and it pours a bucket back out in front of you.
Other mods see it as an ordinary fluid container, so pipes and filling machines can fill and drain it while it sits in your pack.
